name: NYC Cooling Tower Registrations
description:
This dataset lists registered cooling towers in New York City, with one row per tower system and 16 columns covering location, registration, and sampling details. Each record includes a building identification number (BIN), system ID, registration date, street address, borough, ZIP code, and geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude). It also contains administrative geography fields such as community board, council district, census tract, and neighborhood tabulation area (NTA) code. Additional fields describe the number of active equipment units per system and scheduled sampling dates, which appear to follow a recurring multi-visit pattern.

The data is heavily concentrated in Manhattan (about 73% of rows), followed by Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, and Staten Island. Some fields have notable gaps: community board is missing for roughly 36% of rows, BBL for 22%, and sampling dates for about 10%. A few coordinates are zero or otherwise invalid, so location data should be cleaned before mapping.
